# Close wrap — Wed 2026-11-25 (~4:30 PM ET)

**Indexes:** Dow +164.25 (+0.33%) to 50,182.95; S&P 500 −0.25% to 7,182.78; Nasdaq −0.62% to 23,585.80. At the lows, the Dow was down >1,100 points (−2.2%), the Nasdaq −4.6% and the S&P −3.2% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html)). The selloff came from hot Oct core PCE (3.3% y/y) and the formal tariff proposal (20%+ on China, from Jan 2027 at the earliest) (X news). The rebound came on light pre-holiday volume and Burry's "temporarily almost entirely long" post (CNBC). Materials, energy and real estate rose; IBM, CRM and SHW led the Dow. XLK was ~−1% (CNBC). CNN Fear & Greed hit 9 intraday (X news).
**AI hardware:** NVDA ~−4%, MU −4.5% and ORCL >−5% (CNBC). BNP Exane cut MU to Neutral on memory-glut fears (X news). HPQ closed $31.12 after its beat ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/HPQ)). DELL closed $297.06 (+0.60%) and was −0.5% after hours ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/DELL/history/)).
**Covered holds:** BBY $102.57 (+3.0% vs the $99.62 entry). DLTR $152.21 (−1.9% vs the $155.20 entry). TJX $146.11. TGT $172.17 ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/BBY)). Note: exa's daily % uses a stale prior close, so I used only its closing prices.
**After hours:** No notable reports before the holiday.
**Setup:** Thu closed; Fri half day (1 PM). MSCI deletions (MSTR, CTVA) take effect after the 11/30 close. CRM reports 12/2 AMC.

**Avoid review (11/25 close):** The AI-hardware/semis whole-group avoid is HELD because there is still no stabilization. 11/30 avoids move to 12/01, with the review at the 11/30 close (11/22 buffer lesson).

## Swing ideas
None. Intraday the Nasdaq fell −4.6%, and tariffs and the hike risk are unresolved (lesson 11/06). Existing holds are unchanged.
